_about: The CREDITS and HELP windows (Settings > MORE; entities/infoWindow.js). A window = a title + sections {head, lines}. help.fromGlossary = glossary.json basics shown by title (the text lives there, not here). credits: keep in step with src/assets/*/LICENSE*.txt and docs/credits-sounds.md (CC BY-SA music MUST be credited). layout = screen px. PLAN (user): HELP will become the crypto help (wallet, Solana, Seeker, payments) when the Solana / Seeker integration is built.

sections.head: MUSIC
lines: Title Theme by xDeviruchi, from the 8-Bit Fantasy & Adventure Music Pack (CC BY-SA 4.0).
RPG Battle Themes by Pixel-boy and Sparklin Labs (CC0), rearranged for this game.

sections.head: SOUND EFFECTS
lines: Pixabay creators: freesound_gamestudio, yodguard, universfield, dragon-studio, djartmusic, biww and freesound_community.
Public domain (CC0) collections by lavenderdotpet and PanderMusubi.

sections.head: FONTS
lines: Soldia Small: based on Press Start 2P by CodeMan38 (SIL Open Font License 1.1).

sections.head: MOVING
lines: Tap the empty floor: the whole squad walks there.

sections.head: MORE
lines: The GLOSSARY at camp explains damage, items, statuses and every enemy you have met.
